## A Wilderness Retreat Where Nature Meets Comfort

Tucked away in the heart of Pench National Park, Mahua Vann offers a serene jungle escape. Here, rustic charm blends seamlessly with modern comfort, creating a space where you can truly disconnect and unwind. Spend your days on thrilling jeep safaris, exploring the rich biodiversity of Pench, or enjoying scenic cycling trails. As night falls, gather around a starlit bonfire or indulge in a magical riverbed dinner.

#### Stay…

In the Heart of the Jungle. Our handcrafted mud cottages and Machaans are designed to harmonise with the forest, offering large bay windows that frame stunning views. Thoughtfully equipped with modern amenities like air conditioning, a tea & coffee maker, and a private vanity area, they provide the perfect balance of nature and luxury.

#### Deluxe

#### Cottages with Deck

#### Dining

Our menu is inspired by the land, featuring seasonal, locally sourced ingredients. From regional delicacies like Chulai ki Bhaaji and Mahua Kheer to international favorites, every meal is a celebration of fresh flavors. Enjoy dining under the open sky, by the river, or in the privacy of your cottage.

#### Experiences

Spot rare birds, take a dip in our pool, explore jungle trails, or watch a wildlife documentary under the stars. Every experience at Mahua Vann is crafted to bring you closer to nature while ensuring complete relaxation.

#### Jungle Safari

Experience the thrill of observing wildlife during their most active hours with our morning and evening game drives or jungle safaris. Our open and comfortable vehicles offer a panoramic view of the area, allowing you to fully immerse yourself in the sights and sounds of the wild. Led by our team of expert guides, you and your party will embark on a journey through the reserve, encountering a diverse array of animals along the way.

#### Visit to Kohka Lake

Embark on a memorable journey to Kohka Lake, where nature’s enchantment awaits your discovery. This hidden gem promises an experience that will forever linger in your heart. As you step into its tranquil embrace, you’ll be greeted by a world of natural wonders. Kohka Lake is a sanctuary of serenity, a place where time slows down, and the beauty of nature takes center stage.

#### Bird Watching

Our Private Eco Park spans 37 acres and offers bird watching tours led by experienced guides who possess extensive local knowledge. Due to the vast natural forested estate with negligible human interference, the lodge itself is a treasure trove for birding enthusiasts. Our naturalists have recorded a variety of species of birds in the lodge itself.

#### Candle Light Bush Dinner

Nestled within the forest, an open space immerses you in a dining experience like no other. As the day transitions to night, embrace the tranquil ambiance and the twinkle of stars above. Enjoy relaxed evenings around a bonfire, filled with captivating conversations, jungle stories, and delightful food.

#### Visit to Potter's Village

Explore ‘Pachdhar,’ a village adjoining Pench National Park, where over 100 ‘Kumhars’ families have upheld the art of pottery. Engage with local artisans, witness their craft, and even try pottery-making yourself. Collect souvenirs to cherish this cultural experience in the midst of nature.

#### Serene Nature Walk

Discover solace in a serene nature walk. Amid whispering woods, you’ll find respite from the daily rush. Inhale the earthy scents, bask in dappled sunlight, and relish birds’ melodies. Let the tranquil surroundings clear your mind, rejuvenate your spirit, and provide a peaceful sanctuary away from life’s chaos.

#### Wildlife Documentaries

After a thrilling day of spotting tigers at Pench National Park, take a moment to engage in a conversation with our in-house naturalist or indulge in a wildlife documentary to revisit your experience.

#### Conferences

Take your corporate gatherings to the next level at Mahua Vann Resort, where breathtaking river and forest views set the stage for an extraordinary experience. Our fully equipped conference hall ensures a seamless event with comfortable seating, free internet access, advanced projectors, refreshing-air conditioning and good quality audio-visual systems. Immerse yourself in the premium ambience of our Jungle Resort, where nature’s beauty blends with productive business objectives.

#### Swimming

Our jungle resort’s stunning swimming pool is nestled amidst lush greenery and vibrant flora offering a refreshing escape. Dive into the crystal-clear waters or relax by the pool to the soothing sounds of nature. Experience pure bliss in this tropical paradise.

#### Cycling

Discover the thrill of cycling through the peaceful jungle resort, where lush greenery rejuvenates you at every turn. Explore winding trails and breathe in the fresh, earthy scent of nature. Perfect for adventurers and nature lovers alike.

#### Indoor and Outdoor Games

Families and friends can enjoy the perfect holiday with a mix of adventure and relaxation. While you engage in friendly table tennis and carrom competition indoors, the outdoor play area offers a safe haven for kids to explore and play. Create cherished memories together in this vibrant, family-friendly oasis.

#### Karaoke

Sing your favorite songs, laugh, and bond over shared melodies in the tranquil surroundings, creating lasting memories amidst the enchanting backdrop of nature.

#### Tiger Safari

Embarking on a tiger spotting safari in Tadoba National Park is a thrilling adventure, guided by skilled trackers who navigate this pristine, less commercialised sanctuary. The untouched beauty of the landscape enhances the experience and recent estimates reveal a remarkably high tiger density of 115 tigers, boasting the highest Sighting Rating Index in the country. Each moment is a memorable encounter with nature’s majesty.

#### River Walk

As you stroll along the peaceful Hattinala River, the harmonious sound of flowing water, chorus of chirping birds and the soft rustling of leaves serenade your senses. Explore the lush green jungle around you and uncover hidden wonders with every leisurely step. Immerse yourself in the untouched beauty of nature.

A hidden gem is the villages near the property, where warm hospitality invites you into a realm of captivating traditions, enriching your journey with meaningful experiences and lasting memories. Don’t miss a visit to the local bamboo crafts market, where you can admire and purchase exquisite handmade creations that reflect the area’s vibrant artistry.

## A Peaceful Farm Stay by the Arabian Sea

Escape to a coastal retreat set within a 27-acre orchard, just 6 km from Murud Beach. Mahua Bagh is a tranquil hideaway where lush greenery meets the ocean breeze, offering a perfect blend of relaxation and nature.

#### Stay…

Unwind in our nature-inspired accommodations, designed to maximize comfort and views. Choose from 6 Cottage Rooms with stunning sea views or 4 Verandah Rooms surrounded by greenery, each crafted to provide a serene getaway.

#### Dining

Our restaurant brings you the best of Maharashtrian cuisine, fresh seafood, and aromatic curries, using locally sourced ingredients. Enjoy open-air dining with breathtaking views or indulge in a specially curated three-course buffet.

#### Experiences

Take peaceful walks through mango and coconut groves, explore historic forts, or visit nearby wildlife sanctuaries. Enjoy boat rides, fishing, beach picnics, bonfire evenings, and traditional head massages—a complete coastal escape.

#### Beach Activities

Nestled by the Arabian Sea, Mahua Bagh, Murud is a charming resort offering a range of beachside activities for an unforgettable holiday. Enjoy exhilarating boat rides, relax on the shore, and immerse yourself in the natural beauty of the surroundings.

#### Phansad Wildlife Sanctuary

During your stay at Mahua Bagh, Murud, don’t miss the chance to visit the Phansad Wildlife Sanctuary. Just a short drive away, this sanctuary offers the stunning coastal woodland ecosystem of the Western Ghats, flora and fauna, perfect for bird watchers. Experience serene trails, vibrant wildlife, and breathtaking landscapes that enrich your beach getaway.

#### Janjira & Padmadurg Forts

Perched on islands, these historic marvels offer stunning coastal views and a glimpse into Maharashtra’s rich heritage. Explore the iconic Murud-Janjira & Padmadurg Fort’s impressive architecture and immerse yourself in the fascinating stories of their past.

#### Khokari Tombs

Explore Khokari Tombs, the intriguing mausoleums of the Siddis. These historic structures showcase stunning architecture and rich cultural heritage. Wander through the peaceful grounds, appreciate the craftsmanship, and learn about the fascinating stories of the regional rulers of Murud and Janjira, making your visit truly enriching.

#### Garambi Waterfall

This hidden gem features cascading waters surrounded by lush greenery, creating a serene escape. Perfect for nature lovers, the waterfall offers a refreshing dip and a tranquil atmosphere, making it a must-visit destination during your stay.

**Source:** https://mahuaresorts.com/about-us/

### About Mahua Resorts – Where Adventure Meets Tranquility

At Mahua Resorts, we offer more than just a stay—we offer immersive nature experiences in India.

Born from a love for open spaces and a passion for the wild, Mahua Resorts is a collection of boutique eco lodges where every moment is memorable, meaningful, and rooted in nature.

Our Signature Eco Lodges in India

Mahua Vann, Pench

Our first resort, inspired by the traditional tribal Mahua brew. Located near Pench National Park, it offers a deep connection to the forest and its wildlife. 4 kms from Turia Safari Gate of Pench National Park.

Mahua Tola, Tadoba

An authentic jungle escape at Tadoba Andhari Tiger Reserve (TATR). Here, you’ll find raw wilderness, tiger sightings, and uninterrupted peace. 10 kms from Kolara Core Safari Gate.

Mahua Bagh, Murud

A hidden gem on India’s west coast. Set amidst orchards and overlooking a quiet beach, it’s also home to Buddy, our friendly in-house Labrador.

From dense forests to pristine beaches, Mahua Resorts invites you to explore the best boutique eco resorts in India. Reconnect with nature, experience local culture, and create lasting memories in some of the country’s most breathtaking landscapes.

## Mahua Resorts Terms and Conditions

Welcome to the official Mahua Resorts Terms and Conditions page. This section outlines our payment, cancellation, and check-in policies to ensure complete transparency and a smooth booking experience for all our guests. At Mahua Resorts, we strive to offer exceptional hospitality while maintaining fairness and clarity in our processes.

### Payment Terms – Mahua Resorts Terms and Conditions

To confirm your reservation, a 50% advance payment for the resort and 100% advance for safari bookings(optional) must be made at the time of confirmation. The remaining balance must be cleared at least 7 days before check-in. For reservations made within 7 days of the check-in date, 100% advance payment is required upon booking.

These payment guidelines help us ensure a smooth check-in experience and provide the best possible service at Mahua Resorts.

### Cancellation Policy

We understand that travel plans can change. As outlined in the Mahua Resorts Terms and Conditions, our cancellation policy is as follows:

Please note that safari bookings, group bookings, and stays during long weekends, festival holidays, Christmas, and New Year are non-refundable under any circumstance..

### Check-In and Check-Out Information

Check-in time is from 2:00 PM, and check-out is by 11:00 AM. Early check-in and late check-out are subject to availability and can be requested in advance. As stated in the Mahua Resorts Terms and Conditions, our policies are created to balance guest comfort with operational efficiency.

If you have any questions or need assistance regarding the Mahua Resorts Terms and Conditions, feel free to contact our team for any clarification.. We look forward to hosting you.
